subject: VectorWorks renewal — scope alignment, term change & carve-outs
messages:
From: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@vectorworks.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@vectorworks.com, legal@vectorworks.com
Date: 2029-05-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal paperwork + scope questions

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the renewal reminder — VectorWorks is keen to move forward but we need to lock a few pieces before legal will sign. High level:
- Term: we'd prefer moving from 12mo to 24mo to smooth pricing and avoid churn.
- Capacity: we expect a ~2.5x uplift on token usage and want explicit burst capacity + ramp schedule in the order form.
- Termination carve-out: our legal is asking for a carve-out on termination for regulatory data-export obligations (they need 90 days post-termination data access).

I've attached our Renewal_Request PDF with current numbers and the procurement team is standing by for a draft MSA/order form with redlines. Can you route to legal and ops to confirm feasibility and timing?

Goal: get a signed DocuSign within 2 weeks if we can align.

Thanks,
Caroline Wu
Head of Platform Partnerships
VectorWorks

Attachment: VectorWorks_Renewal_Request_2029.pdf (1.2MB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@vectorworks.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2029-05-21T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + scope questions

Caroline — thanks for the clear ask and for the packet. Looping in our legal and infra leads to scope this out. Quick answers up front:
- Term: 24 months is fine from pricing standpoint; we'll need legal to update Exhibit A (term + billing cadence).
- Capacity: ops needs a short questionnaire to pin expected concurrency and burst patterns; see note to Dev below.
- Data export carve-out: we'll review standard language and propose a limited carve-out that preserves our data retention/backup SLA while meeting your regulatory needs.

Plan:
1) Lauren will produce MSA + order form redlines for your review by EOD 5/22.
2) Dev will confirm capacity/burst feasibility and provide recommended order-form language for burst and proration by 5/23.
3) I'll consolidate and send a single proposed package + DocuSign link with a 48-hr review window.

Deal id for tracking: RW-2029-472 (HubSpot).

Karthik Iyer

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Date: 2029-05-22T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + scope questions

Thanks Karthik / Caroline (copied for context).

Summary of legal plan and open items:
- I will produce a redline package covering: MSA term extension (12 -> 24), revised Exhibit A (billing cadence & proration), and an addendum that addresses the limited termination/data export carve-out.
- For the carve-out we will propose: 1) 90-day data access window post-termination, 2) mutually agreeable export format, 3) fees limited to reasonable labor costs (capped).
- SLA language: we will add a paragraph in the order form for sustained throughput guarantees and a burst statement (best-effort vs guaranteed). Please confirm what the product can guarantee.

Attachments: MSA_redline_tracker.xlsx (tracker with sections + ownership).

Open items for Dev (please answer inline in the tracker by EOD 5/23):
A) Can we commit to a sustained token throughput baseline for the 24-month term? If not, what language should we propose?
B) For burst capacity, propose either (i) guaranteed burst up to X for Y minutes per month, or (ii) best-effort burst with priority queueing.

Once I have Dev's answers, I'll finalize redlines and send to VectorWorks legal with commentary.

- Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2029-05-23T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal paperwork + scope questions — capacity notes

Quick ops note — capacity profile below and suggested order-form wording. Attaching the capacity profile YAML for your tracker.

Operational facts:
- Current steady-state throughput: ~120k tokens/minute.
- Expected uplift per VectorWorks forecast: ~2.5x steady-state -> ~300k tokens/minute.
- Burst: we can support bursts to ~450k tokens/min for up to 15 minutes/month with prior reservation (reserved burst pool).
- Guaranteed sustained baseline: we can commit to 300k tokens/min sustained on Dedicated pool if VectorWorks commits to a 24-month reserved capacity line and associated monthly minimums.

Suggested order-form language (short):
"Sustained Throughput: Redwood will maintain a sustained throughput baseline of 300,000 tokens per minute. Burst Capacity: Redwood will provide reserved burst capacity up to 450,000 tokens per minute for aggregated 15 minutes per calendar month. Additional burst usage will be billed at standard overage rates and is subject to availability."

Notes: we need a 30-day lead time to provision Dedicated capacity and GPU reservations for the baseline; recommend including provisioning timeline in the order form.

Attachment: capacity_profile.yaml (stub).

— Dev
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Caroline Wu <caroline.wu@vectorworks.com>, procurement@vectorworks.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com, legal@vectorworks.com
Date: 2029-05-24T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + scope questions — proposed package & next steps

Caroline — appreciate the quick turnaround. Attached is our consolidated package: proposed Order Form with Exhibit A updates, the MSA redline summary, and a short implementation timeline. Highlights:
- Term: 24 months (aligned).
- Pricing/credits: updated to reflect committed reserved capacity for baseline throughput; we've included a 10% committed-capacity discount across the 24-month term (internal approval on discount confirmed).
- Throughput & burst language: per Dev's note — sustained 300k tokens/min baseline, burst to 450k tokens/min for 15 minutes/month. Provisioning lead time: 30 days from signature.
- Data export carve-out: proposed limited 90-day export window post-termination; export fees capped at a fixed labor maximum (see clause 7.3 in redline).

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached Proposed_OrderForm_VectorWorks_2029.docx and MSA_redline_tracker.xlsx.
2) If OK, we'll send a DocuSign envelope (link below) with the Order Form and Addendum for execution — aim to have countersigned within 48hrs of your approval.
3) Ops will schedule a provisioning kickoff on signature.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/vecw-renewal-2029
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/472RW-VectorWorks (deal RW-2029-472)

If VectorWorks legal wants to swap alternate language on the carve-out, please share redlines directly and Lauren will negotiate. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call if that helps close this out.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
